status.scope_reason: The company distributes and commercially markets finished generic sacubitril and valsartan tablets in the United States.
status.evidence: According to DailyMed, Umedica Laboratories USA Inc. distributes FDA-approved generic sacubitril and valsartan film-coated tablets within the United States.

claims.claim: Umedica Laboratories USA Inc. received US FDA approval for its generic sacubitril and valsartan oral formulation under ANDA 219946 on August 4, 2026, according to the FDA Orange Book registry via DrugPatentWatch.
claims.source: FDA Orange Book and DrugFuture registry for ANDA 219946

claims.claim: Umedica Laboratories USA Inc. provides its sacubitril and valsartan medication in film-coated tablet dosage forms available in 24/26 mg, 49/51 mg, and 97/103 mg strengths as listed on Drugs.com.
claims.source: FDA DailyMed labeling database for Umedica Laboratories USA Inc. Sacubitril and Valsartan tablets

claims.claim: Amoli Organics, a division of Umedica Laboratories Pvt. Ltd., manufactures the sacubitril/valsartan active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) substance under an active Drug Master File with a written confirmation by the Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation dated September 30, 2025.
claims.source: Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO) Written Confirmation file 7-5/2013/EU/WC-0077 dated September 30, 2025

claims.claim: Umedica Laboratories USA Inc. received final FDA approval under ANDA 219946 for generic sacubitril and valsartan tablets in 3 strengths.
claims.source: FDA Orange Book and DailyMed registration for ANDA 219946

claims.claim: Umedica Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. manufactures generic sacubitril and valsartan film-coated tablets at its facility in Vapi, Gujarat, India, for distribution in the U.S. market by Umedica Laboratories USA Inc., according to the product's official FDA DailyMed labeling.
claims.source: Official FDA DailyMed labeling for Sacubitril and Valsartan tablets (Packager: Umedica Laboratories USA Inc., Manufactured by: Umedica Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. Vapi, Gujarat)

claims.claim: Umedica Laboratories Pvt. Ltd.'s division, Amoli Organics, operates a facility in Vadodara, India, that maintains an active U.S. FDA Drug Master File (DMF) for the sacubitril/valsartan active pharmaceutical ingredient (API).
claims.source: PharmaTek Directory / PharmaCompass / CDSCO India Certificates

claims.claim: Umedica Laboratories USA Inc. secured final approval from the U.S. FDA under ANDA 219946 on August 4, 2026, to market generic sacubitril and valsartan oral tablets in 24/26 mg, 49/51 mg, and 97/103 mg strengths, as documented in the FDA Orange Book.
claims.source: FDA Orange Book / Drugs.com Generic Availability Data
